silentguard.roleDetails: Designing and implementing a local dlp engine for inline ai sessions for catching the sensitive data leaks and auditing sessions all in a single chrome extension
silentguard.detailedProblemStatement: There was no such DLP engine that was capable of running on a lower end machine with low latency. All of the solutions were cloud based and also expensive and were hard to setup. All of the solutions didnt support the document types that too in low latency and the configurability of the existing engines were also not upto the mark. So making a native solution that runs on consumer machines in low cost supporting hundreds of guardrails and platforms with maximum configurability was the goal. Also, the solution has another mode that can audit the browser ai sessions in order to trace the user sessions and audit them and make them more secure while totally offloading legal liability and compliance burden from the user.
detailedSolution: Designing a low maintainable system with high performance that can audit the ai tools sessions on the browser
Using a qunatised onnx model for catching the non deterministic guardrails
Using regex for the simple and guardrails having a common pattern

Supporting multiple files and bigger prompt in two pass so that while the user is chatting in with the model the context of the documents is already redacted in the first pass before passing the prompt to the model
We shifted from a local microservice architecture that talks via pipes to a single fused extension architecture for more security and less latency
We properly segregated our content-scripts(the interceptor), the background scripts(the processor) and the offscreen document(for model inferencing)
challenges: Running the model under 100MBs and making it run under 500ms for low latency and high user experience
Making sure if any query has violated any harmful guardrail then immediatedly cut the loop and notify the user
Integrating the application with 500 ai tools and making sure that the interception dont break in case of minor changes in UI of that tool
